thesis: The accusation becomes a demand for conditions under which valuable virtues resist unilateral use.

ideas.statement: Responsibility should track relevant power without total-control exemption; helpers can do real good while sustaining exploitative arrangements.
Conscience both obeys and resists; identities, shame and scruples can be manipulated, while endless doubt can excuse inaction.
Gratitude does not grant ownership, forgiveness does not require restored access, and care must permit refusal without erasing attachment.
Civility, transparency, humility and merit can protect or conceal rank; usable contestation and relevant contribution distinguish their functions.
